name: Aurevia Practice OS — Missed Call Recovery Engine

parameters.content:
## Missed-Call Recovery & Compliance Workflow
1. Webhook receives missed call event from phone provider (Twilio / Bland / CallRail / Mock).
2. Validates phone number and clinic ID.
3. Checks opt-out status (STOP list).
4. Evaluates quiet hours for clinic timezone.
5. Enforces duplicate call_id and 24h frequency cap suppression.
6. Sends compliant WhatsApp/SMS message without promising specific callback times.
7. Logs event to Missed Calls CRM tab.
